# dokku_maintenance_custom_page (Data Source)

Installs or removes a custom maintenance page for a dokku application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_maintenance_custom_page" "example" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Inline HTML stored as maintenance.html on the app
- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
